simple.meaning: to suspend ; figuratively (through hesitation) to be uncertain ; by implication (of mental dependence) to habituate
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תָּלָא (H8511) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: תָּלָא (tâlâʼ) means to suspend ; figuratively (through hesitation) to be uncertain ; by implication (of mental dependence) to habituate First listed occurrence: Deut 28 66.

definitions.short: to suspend ; figuratively (through hesitation) to be uncertain ; by implication (of mental dependence) to habituate
definitions.full: H8511. tala תָּלָא verb hang (|| form of תלה , Ges § 75rr ); — Qal Perfect 3plural suffix תְּלָאוּם 2Sam 21:12 Qr the Philistines had hanged them (Kt תלום ; see Dr); Passive participle תְּלֻאִים Deut 28:66 thy life shall be hung up before thee, i.e. be in suspense, each moment uncertain. — לִמְשׁוּבָתִי תְלוּאִים וְעַמִּי Hosea 11:7 my people is hung up to my backsliding is certainly corrupt (AV bent to backsliding from me , i.e. huge or swung toward turning from me, compare GASm, but very dubious); Marti conjectures אֶלעֲֿצַבִּים נִלְוִים ; Oettli Now 2Harper נִלְאָה or הֶלְאַ֫נִי has wearied itself [ me ] in backsliding. [ תַּלְאֻבָה ] see לאב . תְּלָאָה see לאה .
